commands.name: stringn
arguments: @HELP BUILD THE HANGING GARDENS OF SEMIRAMIS!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Look for a site to build the Gardens!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Deliver 80 wood, 40 stones, 40 clay and 40 tiles to the Gardens for the artificial mountain terraces!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Build 9 wells near the Gardens to produce water.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Free the shepherds' wives to earn their cattle and the piece of the construction plan.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay the robbers 50 coins or fight them.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Take the women back to their village.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay the Babylonians a tribute of 5 iron for their brave soldiers.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay the Kobulians a tribute of 10 shoes.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Take your heroes back to the Gardens!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: We established a new settlement near the old riverbed of the Euphrates, as this was the site where the legendary Hanging Gardens of Semiramis were said to have defied the desert ...
